heading: The next opening.
introduction: Barn doors, reimagined. Folding walls. Light filters. A few ideas that bend the definition of a door.
disclosure: AI-generated design concepts · not completed Jeff projects or available products.

items.title: The sculpted slider
items.description: A familiar sideways motion, with flowing contours that turn the whole slab into a piece of wall sculpture.
items.alt: AI concept of an oak sliding door with carved wave relief, partly open beside a warm living room

items.title: The light filter
items.description: Rounded bronze frames and honey-colored glass make the boundary part of the room’s changing light.
items.alt: AI concept of rounded bronze-framed amber glass sliding panels casting striped sunlight beside a dining room

items.title: The folding wall
items.description: A hinged timber screen gathers into a zigzag, letting two rooms borrow a little space from each other.
items.alt: AI concept of four tall slatted walnut panels folded into a zigzag between a reading room and dining space

items.title: The quiet pivot
items.description: A soft coral surface, rounded corners, and an offset turn give the opening a completely different presence.
items.alt: AI concept of a coral terrazzo-faced pivot door turned within a cream plaster opening, with a teal chair beyond
